sources: code.claude.com/docs (skills, sub-agents, hooks, permissions, plugins); live headless /forge runs with Claude Code 2.1.327 (2026-11-19)

entryCommand.native: `/forge <request>`. The installer adds the standalone skill, so the command is bare; as a plugin it is `/forge:forge`

skillDir.native: `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}`, or the folder of the loaded SKILL.md

subagents.native: `Agent` tool with `subagent_type: forge-<role>` (a plugin install namespaces it: `forge:forge-<role>`)

foregroundWait.native: pass `run_in_background: false` on every `Agent` call (left unset, Claude Code may start it in the background and the turn ends early); several such calls in one message still run in parallel. `Bash` and `PowerShell` without `run_in_background` block until done (`timeout` up to 600000 ms)

continueSubagent.native: `SendMessage` to the agent's ID (load it with `ToolSearch` first if it is listed only by name)

perCallModel.native: `model: "opus"` or `"sonnet"` on the `Agent` call; the agent file stays unchanged

toolRestriction.native: `tools` / `disallowedTools` in agent frontmatter (read-only roles cannot edit)

gitGuardHook.native: `PreToolUse` hook running `scripts/git-guard.mjs` on FORGE agents and the /forge skill

preApprovedScripts.native: `allowed-tools` on the forge skill, generated from this profile (`preApproved`): FORGE's own files and scripts, the project's test, lint, type check and dev commands, read-only git, localhost checks and the Playwright and DevTools MCP tools. It holds for the turn that ran `/forge`, subagents included; every part of a chained command must match, and anything else (installs, publish, deploy, git writes) still asks

userQuestion.native: `AskUserQuestion` from the main thread (`multiSelect: true` to pick several)

deferredTools.native: `ToolSearch` with `select:<tool>,<tool>` before calling a tool that is listed only by name

browserTools.native: Playwright MCP and Chrome DevTools MCP (`claude mcp add …`); each tool call follows the user's permission rules

backgroundCommands.native: `run_in_background: true`. The result arrives in a later turn, which no longer has the skill's pre-approvals, so FORGE never uses it for its own work

requiredConfig: Install with `scripts/install.sh --target claude` (or `install.ps1 -Target claude`) for the bare `/forge` command.
Optional, for browser QA: the Playwright and Chrome DevTools MCP servers (see docs/installation.md).
limitations: A plugin install namespaces the command (`/forge:forge`) and the agents (`forge:forge-<role>`).
Skill pre-approvals end with the `/forge` turn. A turn started later (for example by a background notification) asks for permission again.
The git guard parses commands; a git alias or a script that runs git internally is not caught. Host deny rules add a layer (docs/security.md).
